name: Triage a list
description: Loops over a list of items, asks the agent to rate each one, keeps the ones above a bar. Shows each, filter and JSON answers.

input.criteria: How urgent is this for a small business owner? 1 is ignore, 5 is act today.
items: Customer says the product arrived broken

config.system: You rate items honestly and briefly. Reply with JSON only.

config.message: Rated {{ steps.loop.output.count }} items. Keepers are in data/out/triage/{{ run.id }}.txt
